query:
INSERT INTO users (
            id, email, kdf_params, kdf_salt, auth_hash, pepper_version,
            recovery_auth_hash, recovery_pepper_version, wrapped_mk, recovery_wrapped_mk
        )
        VALUES ($1, $2::text::citext, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10)
        ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING
        RETURNING id
